decoded_scope: Independent ordinary native decoder smoke is compared in composed results; source-fed operator parity alone does not qualify decoded quality.

native_resources.scope: Single same-run native vision/prefill/two-token measurement, not a throughput benchmark.

limits: 29 processor/vision stages are raw-identical for this single image.
All66 shared F32 stages were hashed, not all are equal. Five original-only vision intermediates are not emitted by ordinary runner; their operators have separate controls.
prefill.positions raw representation differs: original records chronology+THW, native records THW only; raw inequality alone is not a position-math error.
First downstream text embedding difference does not attribute all later error to that stage; quantized weights and decoder math remain separate.
Two-token source-prefix equality is distinct from full177-token completion equality.
Source-pinned Q4 baseline is byte-controlled, but corrected first-logit error is worse and both prefixes are incorrect.
Complete table geometry/domain proof is broader than this single-image model smoke; whole-model quality across geometries is not claimed.
Unsupported CPU/configuration/rounding/coordinate requests retain old path, and every correction remains default-off.
